name: GAtrends
summary: Watches the keywords that matter to you, spots unusual spikes across news, search and communities, pings you in Telegram, and lets you ask Claude or ChatGPT what is rising and why.
description: Watches the keywords that matter to you, spots unusual spikes across news, search and communities, pings you in Telegram, and lets you ask Claude or ChatGPT what is rising and why.

pricing.details: Prices excluding taxes at checkout. Free 0 € — 3 keywords. Starter 11 €/month — 15 keywords, checks every hour, Telegram alerts, 30 days of signal history. Pro 26 €/month — 75 keywords, checks every 15 minutes, Telegram alerts, Claude and ChatGPT connection, full history and CSV export. Business 90 €/month — 300 keywords, checks every 15 minutes, webhook and API, 5 team seats, several Telegram chats, priority support. Enterprise custom. Yearly billing is offered as “2 months free”. 14-day money-back guarantee on the first payment.
